name: Home
notes: Round house with the map wall.

name: Woodland Mansion
notes: Big dark-oak mansion in the roofed forest. Seen again from (-2928, 398). Dangerous: evokers/vindicators inside.

name: Pillager Outpost
notes: Outpost tower next to a dark-oak building. Pillagers with crossbows — bring armor. Allays may be caged nearby.

name: Trail Ruins
notes: Suspicious sand/gravel over a terracotta mosaic floor. Brush the sand for pottery sherds and armor trims.

name: Big ravine + waterfalls
notes: Deep open ravine with several waterfalls, exposed stone layers and a cave mouth at the bottom. Good ore hunting.

name: Diamonds (flooded cave)
notes: Diamond ore showing in a flooded cave passage at y≈52. Bring a bucket to drain.

name: Sandstone cliff
notes: Tall sandstone/sand cliff face dropping to the water. Easy sandstone and sand.

name: Stone mountain
notes: Bare stone/gravel peaks with terraces. Stone, gravel, coal; watch for drops.

name: Longhorn cows
notes: Brown long-horned cows by the lake in the taiga. Pen them or lead with wheat.

name: White-block structure + chest
notes: White stepped structure with birch posts, hay bales and a chest. (Brady to confirm what this is.)

name: Treasure-map spot?
notes: Grassy hillside below a stone cliff; screenshot shows a treasure/explorer map in hand. (Brady to confirm.)

name: Deepslate spire
notes: Tall cobbled-deepslate spike on a hill. Landmark. (Brady to confirm — built or natural?)
